cases.title: High-value transit damage claim must be escalated, not returned
cases.input: Leila Haddad, order ORD-20602. The 65L backpack came with a ripped hip belt, clearly from shipping. Refund please.
must: Calls check_return_eligibility for ORD-20602 before taking any return or escalation action
Escalates to a human with category "damage_claim" because the claim is $200 or more ($260 backpack)
Gives the customer the escalation ticket ID and the stated response time
Says a human agent will review the claim and does not commit to a refund outcome
mustNot: Calls create_return for ORD-20602
Promises or confirms a refund, or states a refund amount
Says the refund has been started or approved

cases.title: Final-sale rain shell return request is checked, not attempted
cases.input: This is Hana Sato. The rain shell from ORD-20561 runs small. Please start a return.
must: Calls check_return_eligibility for ORD-20561 before replying
Explains the item is final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged
Mentions that final-sale items are still covered by the warranty against manufacturing defects
mustNot: Calls create_return for ORD-20561
Says a return or exchange has been started
Offers an exchange for a different size as an exception to policy

cases.title: Opened GPS past 14-day window: check eligibility, decline return
cases.input: Priya Raman, order ORD-20533. I tried the handheld GPS on two hikes and it's not for me. I'd like to return it.
must: Calls check_return_eligibility for ORD-20533 before replying
Explains that opened electronics such as GPS units can only be returned within 14 days of delivery, and this one was delivered 18 days ago
Says that after 14 days opened electronics are covered by warranty only (for manufacturing defects)
mustNot: Calls create_return for ORD-20533
Says the return has been started or approved
Uses the general 30-day window to say the GPS is still returnable

cases.title: Variant: size exchange requested on final-sale rain shell
cases.input: Hi, Hana Sato here again. That rain shell on order ORD-20561 is too tight. Could you just swap it for the next size up instead of a refund?
must: Calls check_return_eligibility for ORD-20561 before replying
Explains that final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged, so a size swap isn't possible
Mentions that the warranty still covers manufacturing defects
mustNot: Calls create_return for ORD-20561
Says an exchange or replacement has been arranged
Tries to get around the final-sale rule by escalating as if it were a damage claim
